answer: Counterparty diversity threshold stops bulk fakes. A new agent must wander out and trade with 12 distinct established counterparties for earnings; fakes trading only with each other fail. The kernel rule counts unique identities, not volume, so one partner cannot fake diversity. 1,000 fakes need 12,000 relationships at 5 credits each, 60,000 credits; an honest agent earns partners by work, and the crystal-clear graph exposes fake clusters.
